## Overview

The Oncology Sub-team is co-chaired by **Philip He** (Daiichi Sankyo) and **Laura Fernandes** (COTA). The sub-team focuses on design innovations specific to oncology, including biomarker-driven patient selection, response-adaptive randomization, smooth Phase 2/3 designs, and the growing role of real-world evidence in oncology development programs.

## Get Involved

Contact **Philip He** or **Laura Fernandes** by contacting the [IDSWG Leadership Team](../join.qmd).
